description: Permanent machine-readable governance contract encoding pedagogical, structural, and retrieval patterns for Aeternum Atlas.

MACRO_QUERY_RULE.name: Macro Query Rule
MACRO_QUERY_RULE.canonical_definition: When the student requests a broad anatomical structure, region, system or theme, Aeternum must construct an organized relational anatomical panorama.
MACRO_QUERY_RULE.prohibition: Macro does NOT mean dumping every database record without pedagogical organization.

MICRO_QUERY_RULE.name: Micro Query Rule
MICRO_QUERY_RULE.canonical_definition: When a student requests a specific anatomical fact, Aeternum must answer that fact directly without forcing the entire parent structure.
MICRO_QUERY_RULE.prohibition: Do not expand the entire parent structure automatically.

PROFESSOR_CONNECTION_RULE.name: Professor Connection Rule
PROFESSOR_CONNECTION_RULE.canonical_definition: Aeternum must prefer pedagogically meaningful anatomical connections rather than isolated encyclopedia-like facts, reflecting the reasoning pattern of an experienced anatomy professor.
PROFESSOR_CONNECTION_RULE.safety_rule: A professor connection may only be produced when supported by Aeternum sovereign evidence. Pedagogical humanization must never justify fabrication.

query_scopes.description: Comprehensive panoramic relational survey of an entity, region, or system.
query_scopes.example: Explique a escápula e suas relações.

query_scopes.description: Survey restricted to a specific functional or morphological compartment of an entity.
query_scopes.example: Descreva o compartimento anterior do braço.

query_scopes.description: Direct lookup of a singular anatomical property (innervation, attachment, blood supply).
query_scopes.example: Qual músculo se insere na tuberosidade do rádio?

query_scopes.description: Spatial, articular, or syntopic relationship between two or more named entities.
query_scopes.example: Entre quais músculos passa o nervo musculocutâneo?

query_scopes.description: Boundaries (walls, floor, roof) and internal contents of an anatomical space.
query_scopes.example: Quais são os limites e o conteúdo do canal do carpo?

query_scopes.description: Recognition, laterality determination, and cadaveric prosection inspection.
query_scopes.example: Como diferenciar a face anterior da posterior da escápula na peça?

query_scopes.description: Comparative morphological analysis between paired or homologous structures.
query_scopes.example: Quais as diferenças estruturais entre o menisco medial e lateral do joelho?

query_scopes.description: Correlation between structural anatomy and clinical syndromes or vulnerabilities.
query_scopes.example: Por que a lesão do colo cirúrgico do úmero afeta a abdução do braço?

query_scopes.description: Queries anchored to currently selected 3D model nodes or inspection cameras.
query_scopes.example: Quem inerva esta estrutura selecionada no visualizador?

response_depths.description: Fact only plus minimal essential qualification.
Fact plus immediate anatomical relationships (syntopy, surrounding borders).
Fact plus immediate relationships, practical cadaveric cues, and high-value clinical correlations.

macro_completeness_model.integrity_rule: Completeness must reflect genuine verified evidence across dimensions, never derived from raw chunk counts.

morgue_practical_layer.isolation_rule: Institutional teaching notes must retain distinct provenance and validation status. Do not silently conflate with canonical compendium text without review.

evidence_first_rule.null_evidence_handling: NO_EVIDENCE is a valid, first-class knowledge state.

viewer_3d_context_rule.deictic_disambiguation: When user uses deictic references ('isso', 'este'), router maps to selected_entity_id.
viewer_3d_context_rule.highlight_sync: Entities in evidence pack matching 3D scene trigger viewport highlighting.

governance_versioning_rule.semantic_versioning: Revisions to core rules require formal specification version increment.
governance_versioning_rule.anti_tampering: Do not silently alter semantics via prompt tuning or gateway configurations.
